title: What is the amount spent by customer "38508" at the gas stations? How much
question:
What is the amount spent by customer "38508" at the gas stations? How much had the customer spent in January 2012?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: January 2012 refers to the Date value = '201201'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.XCL_011 LIKE '2012-01%' THEN T1.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS amount_spent_jan_2012,
    SUM(T1.XCL_018) AS total_amount_spent
FROM transactions_1k T1
JOIN customers T2 ON T1.XCL_013 = T2.XCL_001
WHERE T2.XCL_002 = '38508'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT (SELECT SUM(t.XCL_018) FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.XCL_013 = 38508 AND t.XCL_015 IS NOT NULL),
       (SELECT y.XCL_021 FROM yearmonth y WHERE y.XCL_019 = 38508 AND y.XCL_020 = '201201')
